How Galactic Empire connects

  • Location: Trantor — Empire rules from Trantor.
  • Character: Bel Riose — Riose is a general of the Galactic Empire.
  • Character: Cleon — Cleon is an emperor of the Galactic Empire.
  • Character: Demerzel — Demerzel serves as the emperor's lasting minister.

What is Galactic Empire?

The Galactic Empire rules millions of worlds from Trantor until decay, periphery wars, and Seldon's mathematics say a thirty-thousand-year dark age is coming.

Key threads lead to Trantor, Bel Riose, Cleon and Demerzel.
